div.head: Af El. 47
div.ab: Ðam ælþeodigan ⁊ uton cumenan ne læt ðu no uncuþlice wið hine, ne mid nanum unryhtum ðu hine ne drece.
Þam elðeodegan ⁊ utan cumenan ne læt ðu no uncuðlice wið hine, ne mid nanum unryhtum þu hine ne drece.
Peregrino molestus non eris, quia ipsi peregrini fuistis in terra Egypti.
Þam elðeodegan ⁊ utan cumenan ne læt ðu no uncuðlice wið hine, ne mid nanum unryhtum þu hine ne drece.
The foreigner and he who has come from afar – do not deal unkindly with him, nor may you afflict him with wrongs.
Dem Fremden und von auswärts Gekommenen gegenüber benimm du dich nicht unfreundlich, und belästige du ihn mit keinen Ungerechtigkeiten.
Towards the foreigner and one who has come from outside do not behave unkindly, and do not trouble him with any injustices.

note.label: related provision
note.quote: Ine §20 deals with "a person who has come from far off or a stranger" who is to be regarded as a thief if he strays off the road
